spoken: Eighty-nine all out? Dhruv, eighty-nine? Chasing three hundred and thirty-four in Mount Maunganui!
Absolute destruction. New Zealand hammered India by two hundred and forty-four runs in the fourth ODI to make it two-one in the five-match series.
How did they get to three hundred and thirty-three in the first place?

Will Young hit a magnificent one hundred and twenty-five off one hundred and eight balls. Tim Seifert supported him with fifty-eight off forty-eight, and Finn Allen smashed forty-one off thirty at the top.
And our batting just folded?
Completely collapsed in twenty-six point four overs. Matt Henry was unplayable, taking career-best figures of six for twenty-seven. This is India's second-heaviest ODI defeat in history.
What did Shreyas Iyer have to say about this?

The stand-in captain pointed to a massive difference in pitch behaviour between the two innings, though he gave full credit to Henry for bowling in the right areas right from ball one. Iyer admitted India tried various bowling combinations to stop New Zealand's aggressive approach, but nothing worked.
Is Rodrygo really looking at an exit from Madrid?

Bernabeu Digital reports Arsenal have renewed their interest in the twenty-five-year-old forward ahead of the January transfer window. They are considering reactivating their pursuit as he recovers from that serious knee injury suffered in March 2026.
Has an offer gone in?
No formal offer has been submitted and no negotiations have started. It is purely early speculation for now.
At least Jude and Trent won with England last night!

They did. England beat Croatia two-one on Thursday night. First, Jude Bellingham's deflected pass found Morgan Rogers, who scooped it in for the lead. Bellingham later set up substitute James Garner for another goal, but that was ruled out for offside. Trent Alexander-Arnold played seventy-eight minutes with sixty-four touches and three tackles before being replaced by Ben White. Bellingham played the full ninety minutes, creating two chances and winning six ground duels. England face Spain on Sunday.
What about the Under-19 Asia Cup? Are we in the final?

Yes, India face Pakistan in the final in Muscat on Saturday, aiming for an eighth title. Pakistan won the toss and asked India to field. Looking back at their record, India have seventeen wins to Pakistan's thirteen in thirty-one meetings. But Pakistan beat India by three wickets in the group stage and won last year's final.
And the IPL trades before retention day are wild!

Four trades involving ten players across six teams have already been sealed. Hardik Pandya heads to Punjab Kings, with Arshdeep Singh joining Mumbai Indians. Rishabh Pant returns to Delhi Capitals, while Kuldeep Yadav joins Lucknow Super Giants. Chennai Super Kings and Sunrisers Hyderabad completed a four-player swap. The mini-auction takes place on December sixteenth in Goa.
Over in Formula One, Kimi Antonelli is already watching out for Max next year.

That is right. The new champion named Max Verstappen as his main threat for 2027. On top of that, Juan Pablo Montoya thinks Liam Lawson has what it takes to replace Max at Red Bull eventually, even after their practice collision in Mexico City. Also, Red Bull named Nikola Tsolov as their official reserve driver for both F1 teams in 2027. And Verstappen has signed an ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK.
What is the update on Carlos Alcaraz before Turin?

Alcaraz admitted to having some physical niggles right before the ATP Finals. Still, he enters Turin on a ten-match winning streak after picking up titles in Tokyo, Vienna, and Paris. Taylor Fritz mentioned he can play at Alcaraz's level on his day, but Carlos's consistency is what separates him from the pack.

Staying with tennis in Stockholm, Thiago Agustin Tirante beat Alejandro Tabilo seven-five, seven-six to reach the final. He will play top seed Taylor Fritz, who defeated Lorenzo Musetti six-four, six-two.
And Golden State got completely flattened without Steph.

San Antonio routed the Warriors one hundred and twenty-three to eighty-five for their eleventh straight win. Golden State fell behind eighteen-nil in minutes. With Steph Curry out for two weeks with a right oblique tear and Brandon Williams nursing a hamstring strain, Steve Kerr started De'Anthony Melton and Yaxel Lendeborg. Melton shot three-for-eleven as the undersized lineup was completely overwhelmed.
What is Novak up to off the court?
Djokovic has joined forces with Aman Group to launch ATMA, a luxury wellness brand. Their first flagship resort will be a supertall tower on Miami's Brickell waterfront, scheduled for 2031.
And Portugal are honoring Cristiano Ronaldo!
The entire Portugal squad will wear the iconic number seven jersey against Denmark, with UEFA approving a special homage in the seventh minute.
McLaren are bringing upgrades to Las Vegas too.

They will introduce new front-wing concept parts for the MCL40. Oscar Piastri admitted he has been manhandling his car this season, going seventeen races without a podium while Lando Norris took victory in Brazil.
In Spain, FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has received a twelve-match ban after his collision with Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel, which tragically led to De Miguel's death the next day.

spoken: What a gutsy win in Mount Maunganui! When India folded for two hundred and nine in the forty-third over, I was bracing for the worst.
They were bundled out in forty-two point one overs. But New Zealand never found rhythm, bowled out for one hundred and eighty-seven in forty-eight point one overs. India win by twenty-two runs.
That takes the five-match ODI series three-one. To defend a total that low after being completely on the back foot? Sensational effort from the attack.
Auqib Nabi took India's Impact Player award for the series. He made the ball talk across the tour.
He really did. What about Dale Steyn reminiscing about Virat Kohli today?
Steyn recalled watching the 2008 Under-19 World Cup final and wondering who this cocky little guy was. Then they shared the RCB dressing room, bonded over food and music, and became close friends.
From cocky teenager to a giant of the game. Now, what is going on with Vinicius Jr at Madrid?

He spoke about his slow start under Jose Mourinho: just one goal and three assists in twelve matches. He said transfer speculation in the summer left him truly overwhelmed before he signed his six-year deal.
Plus Brazil's early round-of-sixteen World Cup exit cut into his routine. He admitted he trained less than usual on holiday. At least he is honest about it.

Mourinho has paired Bernardo Silva with Aurelien Tchouameni in midfield, but Bernardo is not getting younger. Spanish analyst Maldini has put forward Bayern Munich's twenty-two-year-old Aleksandar Pavlovic as the ideal future fix for Madrid's defensive midfield.
Pavlovic is calm on the ball and organizes play brilliantly. That would be smart business. Over at Red Bull, though, the garage is losing another veteran, isn't it?

Chief mechanic Jon Caller is leaving Formula 1 after ten years to join Ford's 2027 Le Mans factory endurance programme. He played a direct role in four drivers' titles and two constructors' championships.
That is a huge loss for Max Verstappen's side of the garage.

And Christian Horner spoke on the High Performance podcast about feeling privately unhappy during Red Bull's dominant run with Verstappen, explaining that tension had mounted before his exit last year.
Winning every weekend and still feeling that strain. It never stops. And Guenther Steiner took aim at Lewis Hamilton?
Steiner and Ralf Schumacher questioned Hamilton's leadership at Ferrari. One win in forty-four starts, sitting fourth, and frustrated with team strategy and racing rules against Charles Leclerc.
Ferrari pressure is unforgiving. Just like the schedule Carlos Alcaraz is dealing with right now.

Greg Rusedski warned that Alcaraz might be overplaying heading into Turin. He is twenty and two since returning from his wrist injury, with titles in Tokyo, Vienna, and Paris, but he has arrived with knee strapping and a stomach complaint.
Rusedski pointed to how Roger Federer and Jannik Sinner managed their loads. Carlos is only twenty-three. He cannot grind his body down this early.
The action in Turin has already started, though. Ben Shelton took down Arthur Fils six-two, three-six, six-three for his first career win at the ATP Finals.
Shelton broke Fils early in the third set and held strong. Massive milestone for him. How did Alexander Zverev look?

Clinical. Zverev beat Rafael Jodar six-four, six-four in under ninety minutes. Jodar said afterwards that Zverev earned world number one with two Grand Slams this season and that no one handed him anything.
Gracious words from the young Spaniard. Where is Novak Djokovic focusing his energy right now?

Holger Rune revealed Djokovic gave him advice on controlling his on-court temper. And off the court, Djokovic has teamed up with Aman Group to launch ATMA, planning a three-hundred-and-twenty-metre wellness tower in Miami by 2031.
Djokovic building health skyscrapers fits him down to the ground. In the NBA, what is Golden State's plan without Steph Curry?
Draymond Green made it simple: he said he will have to shoot more.
Draymond shooting more? That is going to test everyone's patience.
In football, Portugal manager Jorge Jesus stated he is not missing Cristiano Ronaldo after benching him in the Nations League.
Saying that out loud about Cristiano takes pure audacity. Did Haas confirm their Las Vegas seat?
Rafael Camara stays in the car alongside Ollie Bearman, though Ryo Hirakawa drives Bearman's car in first practice.
A huge international farewell: Romelu Lukaku has retired from Belgium duty at thirty-three.
Ninety-four goals in one hundred and thirty-five matches. He finishes fifth on the all-time men's international scoring list, behind only Sunil Chhetri, Ali Daei, Lionel Messi, and Cristiano Ronaldo.

spoken: Carlos looks unstoppable right now! Ten wins in a row after carrying his title-winning form from Vienna and Paris straight into the ATP Finals.
He broke Tiafoe four times and was merciless on the American’s second serve, winning all twelve points played on it. He saved all three break points he faced on his own serve.
And remember, he had tape on his right knee! Did it slow him down?

Not at all. He hit twenty-one winners to just nine unforced errors. Alcaraz said experience has finally taught him how to get the best out of his game on indoor courts. Having spent nearly five months out with a right wrist injury before returning in August, he feels he arrives in Turin with fresh energy and ambition.
He said this is the best he has felt at this part of the season in his career!
He did note that playing Daniil Medvedev next is difficult because you sometimes have to win the point two or three times in long rallies.
Now, what is happening off the pitch at Real Madrid?
Some justice served first. A fan who racially abused Kylian Mbappe during Real Madrid’s win at Real Oviedo in August 2025 has been given an eleven-month suspended prison sentence for a hate crime.

Good! The suspension is conditional on him not attending sports stadiums for official competitions for two years, plus he got a fine and disqualification penalties. Real Madrid acted as private prosecutor.

On the transfer front, fifteen-year-old English wonderkid JJ Gabriel is set to sign a three-year deal with Real Madrid. Los Blancos will pay three hundred and sixty thousand euros in training compensation to Manchester United. Agent Ali Barat visited Valdebebas to tie up final details.
Gabriel snubbed PSG, Bayern Munich, and Barcelona to join us! He goes into the Castilla setup, though federation rules mean he can only play for youth sides until January.
Over on international duty, Vinicius Junior scored his first-ever hat-trick for Brazil in a seven-nil rout of Singapore, following his two goals against Japan last week.

Bruno Guimaraes set up his ninth-minute opener and his twenty-first-minute tap-in. For the second goal in the fifteenth minute, Vini passed to Endrick on a counter-attack, and Endrick unselfishly played it right back to him!

However, former Madrid player Alvaro Benito on Cadena SER questioned Vini's recent comments explaining his sluggish club form. Vinicius had pointed to the emotional impact of Brazil’s early World Cup exit and contract uncertainty.
Benito said it is November seventeenth, Vini is twenty-six, and it sounds like an excuse. What about the Indian cricket team ahead of the New Zealand Test series?
Fast bowler Gurnoor Brar was reprimanded and handed one demerit point by the ICC for an aggressive celebration in Tim Seifert's face during the fourth ODI at Mount Maunganui on November thirteenth.
That takes him to two demerit points in twenty-four months! Virat Kohli actually had to step in and cool tensions.

Brar was player of the series with nine wickets in four matches, and he was drafted into the Test squad as a late replacement for Kuldeep Yadav. Captain Shubman Gill confirmed India will field four fast bowlers in the first Test at Wellington.
Four pacers at the Basin Reserve?

Gill called selecting from six in-form pacers a good headache, naming Brar, Anshul Kamboj, Harshit Rana, and Mohammed Siraj. India are looking at seven proper batters, with the WTC final firmly in sight.

Also, Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi attended the India-Pakistan match at Anvir Cricket Stadium in Dhaka during the Blind Asia Cup, playing on the field and praising the players' inspiring vision.
In Formula One, Max Verstappen had everyone laughing in Brazil over his team radio message complaining about clutch and engine braking on the RB22. He joked his engine doesn't speak English.

He took an engine penalty, started twenty-first, and still recovered to second! But Red Bull chief mechanic Caller is leaving after ten years, four drivers' titles, and two constructors' titles to join Ford's Le Mans challenge.
In the NBA, Golden State Warriors dropped their third straight game, losing one hundred and fifteen to ninety-four against the New Orleans Pelicans.
What went wrong against the Pelicans?

Saddiq Bey scored twenty-three points, leading a twenty-three to two opening run. New Orleans rookie Jeremiah Fears became the youngest Pelican with a triple-double at twenty years old, posting nineteen points, ten rebounds, and ten assists.

Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg put up twenty-eight points and eight rebounds, but Draymond Green said there is too much pressure on Lendeborg while Steph Curry is out with a right oblique tear and Jimmy Butler rehabs his ACL.
On Curry, he signed a two-year, one hundred and sixteen million dollar extension, giving back ten million in cap space, and admitted it could be his last contract.
In wellness, Novak Djokovic has partnered with Aman Group to launch ATMA, a luxury wellness hotel brand, with the first property opening in Miami in 2031.

Fernando Alonso is returning to the Dakar Rally in January 2027 with Aston Martin, driving the Dreadnought alongside Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes with co-driver Marc Coma, before doing the F1 season.
Aston Martin also unveiled a special white, black, and green livery for the Las Vegas Grand Prix in collaboration with CoreWeave.

In tennis, double player Henry Patten criticized ATP chairman Andrea Gaudenzi and CEO Eno Polo for missing the year-end world number one trophy presentation in Turin after he and Harri Heliovaara finished top.
Calling out the ATP leadership right on court!

And Alexander Zverev faces a new civil lawsuit in Berlin filed by ex-partner Brenda Patea over alleged false statements he made claiming his innocence was proven after paying two hundred thousand euros total to state and charity to settle his domestic abuse case.
A couple of quick notes elsewhere. Tony Mowbray has stepped down as Blackburn Rovers head coach due to health reasons following his bowel cancer diagnosis.
And MS Dhoni has officially retired as an IPL player, taking up a mentoring role at Chennai Super Kings.

spoken: I was genuinely worried after Thursday's MRI scan on his left thigh. But Alcaraz walked out with that black bandage and swept past Flavio Cobolli 6-4, 6-1!
That makes it twelve straight wins for the Spaniard. He hit twenty-nine winners, gave Cobolli zero openings on serve, and completed a perfect group stage.
Three wins out of three! He also defeated Daniil Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 earlier in the week. Now it is Ben Shelton in Saturday's semi-final.
He needed a medical timeout against Medvedev, but his medical team cleared him to play. He kept the rallies short against Cobolli and looked fully fit.
Huge news for Real Madrid fans! Thibaut Courtois has signed a contract extension until June 2028!
The 34-year-old Belgian goalkeeper joined from Chelsea in 2018. He has 348 appearances, 133 clean sheets, three LaLiga titles, and two Champions League crowns.
Player of the match in that 2022 Champions League final victory over Liverpool, Yashin Trophy, Golden Glove in 2018... locking him down for two more years is incredible.
Also at Madrid, Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappe, Ousmane Dembele, and Lamine Yamal have been nominated for the 2026 Globe Soccer Awards.
And Vinicius Jr. is back in the squad for Sunday's game against Celta Vigo!

He missed four LaLiga matches following his red card against Villarreal. After scoring five goals in two games for Brazil during the international break, he returns alongside Aurelien Tchouameni and Bernardo Silva. Real Madrid are second with 30 points from 12 matches, three points behind leader Barcelona.
In cricket, India A started their Rising Stars Asia Cup campaign in Doha with a brilliant hundred from Tilak Varma!

After Abhishek Sharma fell for nine and Ayush Badoni went early against Nepal, captain Tilak Varma made 107 off 113 balls. He added 206 runs for the fourth wicket with Kumar Kushagra, who scored 117. Tilak eventually fell caught on the boundary trying to hit Nandan Yadav over long-on.
And what about the first Test in Wellington? Glenn Phillips gave us a hard time on Day 2.

He did. Phillips reached his second Test hundred off 193 balls off Prasidh Krishna. He became the first batter to score a Test, ODI, and T20I hundred against India in a calendar year, building on his partnership with Henry Nicholls.
But Akash Deep got him in the end!

In his first Test after a 16-month absence with a lower-back stress fracture, Akash Deep knocked back the top of off stump. India ended Day 2 at 159 for one, with Jaiswal scoring 85 off 89 balls, trailing New Zealand by 209 runs.
Did you see Krishnamachari Srikkanth questioning how fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is being handled?
Srikkanth strongly criticised the selectors, saying playing him for one match and leaving him out for five is a blunder that discourages young talent.
Over in Formula 1, Max Verstappen had a messy opening day of practice in Las Vegas.

Wet weather limited FP1 with no lap times set. In FP2, Verstappen finished 13th, reporting car balance, handling, and power issues. Technical director Pierre Wache admitted Red Bull have work to do. Still, Max enters Vegas second in the standings after three wins in his past five races.
The Golden State Warriors are in absolute freefall without Steph Curry. Lost 116-94 to Dallas and 126-98 to Memphis.

They have dropped four straight on a winless road trip, falling to 8-7 in the last play-in spot. With Curry out due to an oblique tear, Will Richard scored 20 points off the bench against Dallas, going eight for eight on two-pointers while Cooper Flagg scored 33 for the Mavericks. Steve Kerr says they have to find a way to execute.
Look back at tennis history for a second—Novak Djokovic's epic five-set 2014 Wimbledon final victory over Roger Federer, 6-7, 6-4, 7-6, 5-7, 6-4.

That three-hour and 56-minute match denied Federer an eighth Wimbledon title and earned Djokovic his second. Off the court, Cristiano Ronaldo is co-funding a 22.4 million dollar bottled water plant in Gostei, Portugal, with Maravilha Decimal and Grupo Outeirinho, opening in late 2027.
What is the latest on Formula 1 stewards?

The FIA is recruiting 12 to 15 full-time stewards starting in 2027 to improve officiating consistency. Also, Cadillac CEO Dan Towriss confirmed Valtteri Bottas stays for 2027, keeping Colton Herta as test driver.

Around the grounds. UEFA hit England with a suspended one-match away supporter ban for two years after discriminatory anti-Catholic and anti-Irish chanting during their 3-2 win against Spain in Madrid.
And Blackpool sacked manager Ian Evatt on his birthday! The club posted a birthday wish on social media at 9.08am and announced his departure at 4pm!
